# Runway 14

> Runway 14 builds web apps, websites, SEO, and AI automation for companies that want software that actually works.

Runway 14 is a software development studio. Its four services: full-stack web applications, marketing and brochure websites, on-page and technical SEO, and AI-powered workflow automation. It works with early-stage founders building an MVP and with established teams that already have a product and need more capacity.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ravindulenaduwa.github.io/Runway-Takeoff/): overview, services, process, and FAQ
- [Work With Us](https://ravindulenaduwa.github.io/Runway-Takeoff/work-with-us): project intake form to start a conversation
- [Privacy Policy](https://ravindulenaduwa.github.io/Runway-Takeoff/privacy): what data is collected and how it's handled
- [Terms of Service](https://ravindulenaduwa.github.io/Runway-Takeoff/terms): terms governing use of the site and project engagements
